register_preflight.requested_state: Minimum physically defensible near-surface parent-state for the ARCANA physical-soil/biome-support consumer.

minimum_sufficient_parent_state_contract.purpose: Later provider-schema gate only; no materialization here.
required_fields: surface lithology or mapped unconsolidated material class

variable_reclassification.basis: GLiM is a partial surface-lithology conditioner; bedrock/residual branch still needs explicit classifier.
GUM provides mapped transported sediment classes with incomplete coverage.
GUM is partial direct genetic/depositional authority for transported materials only.
P7S minimum contract does not require mineral-specific reactions; Ito/Wagai and Journet are modern soil mineralogy.
Pelletier supplies a partial present-day thickness constraint.
Useful structural split, but total depth/dz is the minimum consumer requirement.
Needed as the vertical boundary condition; Pelletier is only a constraint.
GUM grain size is categorical/incomplete; a probabilistic class-to-texture adapter is not yet authorized or validated.
Not required by the current P7S minimum contract.
P7S describes bulk density as absent but optional for the candidate pedotransfer path.
P7S explicitly rejects duplicated six-layer profiles and does not demonstrate model-generated layering.
Every future transform must preserve source uncertainty or fail closed.
Modern maps cannot silently become a paleo trajectory.

gum_assessment.dataset: Global Unconsolidated Sediments Map Database v1.0
gum_assessment.access: PANGAEA metadata and download; complete dataset approximately 1.3 GB, not downloaded
gum_assessment.coverage_meaning: Mapped unconsolidated sediments cover about 50% of global ice-free land; average compiled map scale approximately 1:3,000,000; 0.5 degree gridded sediment-type product exists.
gum_assessment.no_polygon_semantics: No GUM polygon cannot be promoted to exposed bedrock or residual material; the paper does not establish that absence as a physical class.
gum_assessment.residual_exclusion: Laterites and other residual deposits are excluded; tropical residual/weathering-mantle cells remain unresolved, not bedrock by default.

attributes.sediment_type: available for mapped units; completeness not quantified beyond mapped coverage
attributes.sediment_subtype: available where source detail supports it; completeness not quantified
attributes.grain_size: 39% of polygons / 41.7% of GUM area, categorical information level YY
attributes.mineralogy: about 8% of polygons, categorical information level ZZ
attributes.age: about 73% of polygons, information level AA
attributes.source_provenance: 126 input datasets and source-map information levels; exact field completeness NOT_QUANTIFIED_FROM_AVAILABLE_PRIMARY_METADATA

age_logic: older_than_200ka: possible only where source age supports it
younger_than_200ka: possible only where source age supports it

spatial.crs: dataset metadata must be bound at acquisition
spatial.arcana_remap: categorical area/majority remap with explicit unknown/ice/water; no remap implemented

glim_residual_bedrock_assessment.role: surface lithology conditioner for an explicitly verified bedrock/residual branch
glim_residual_bedrock_assessment.fallback_rule: GUM mapped transported sediment -> GUM branch; otherwise GLiM only after an independent explicit bedrock/residual classifier
glim_residual_bedrock_assessment.remaining_gap: global classifier separating exposed bedrock, residual regolith/laterite, unmapped sediment and unknown is absent

pelletier_composition.composition: GUM material class + Pelletier structural thickness is conceptually composable, but conflicts must be DATASET_CONFLICT and never silently resolved
conflicts: GUM sediment with near-zero Pelletier sediment thickness
large Pelletier thickness with no GUM class

ito_wagai.license: PANGAEA terms/citation; acquisition metadata to bind
ito_wagai.independence: derived from global soil map / soil-order aggregation; not independent of modern soil classification

journet.independence: partially dependent on global soil-unit/classification expansion; not independent parent-material validation

grain_size_texture.mapping_to_sand_silt_clay: requires empirical/probabilistic adapter; not direct quantitative global fractions
grain_size_texture.soilgrids_comparison: modern endpoint/calibration only, never 200 ka initial state
grain_size_texture.uncertainty_transform: feasible in principle but not implemented or authorized

vertical_profile_adjudication.finding: P7S requires six-layer dz/Ksat/WHC inputs and rejects duplication; neither B homogeneous layers nor C model-generated differentiation is demonstrated by the current contract.

temporal_class_matrix.qualification: only for verified exposed bedrock; not residual cover

temporal_adapter_options.T0_STATIC_WITH_UNCERTAINTY: candidate only for verified bedrock; insufficient for mobile surficial materials
temporal_adapter_options.AGE_GATED_PRESENT_MAP: possible where GUM source age supports a gate, but not persistence
temporal_adapter_options.PROCESS_CONDITIONED_RECONSTRUCTION: new derived model requiring explicit gate
temporal_adapter_options.EVENT_DRIVEN_RECONSTRUCTION: new derived model requiring event histories
temporal_adapter_options.NO_DEFENSIBLE_TEMPORAL_ADAPTER: current status for a complete 200 ka global material trajectory

additional_targeted_candidates.not_authority: does not resolve global residual/surficial material branch
no demonstrated globally harmonized physical parent-material profile

bedrock_residual: ARCANA conditioning only after separate gate
shared: Ito/Wagai or Journet optional modern mineralogy

composite_architecture.dominant_blocker: 200 ka–0 ka temporal adapter plus residual-material classification

cell_level_provenance_contract.numeric_uncertainty: never fabricated; source intervals or unknown retained

missing_data_policy.rule: MISSING_SOURCE never becomes DIRECT_SUPPORTED; GUM absence never becomes bedrock.

remaining_blocking_gaps: 200 ka–0 ka temporal adapter for deposited/residual materials
